StoryDescription: A shepherd boy, a giant warrior, and a God who wins the battle — the story of David and Goliath from 1 Samuel 17, told panel by panel.
PanelImageCredit: Art coming soon — Lorraine's own artwork will appear here.
PanelText: David had won — not with a sword or heavy armor, but with a sling, five stones, and trust in God. “The battle is the Lord's,” he had said, and all Israel saw that God saves His people. When giants stand in your way, remember: the God who stood with David stands with you.
